cutoff_event: Completion of the pinned review-classifier update.

sonnet_baseline.method: All 25 native sessions and captured launcher/CLI records cross-checked. Deduplicate assistant-message IDs and use current-invocation token usage, not session-cumulative CLI cost totals. Reprice at the frozen 21 October 2026 list rates. Process timing includes startup, all tools and shutdown; shared pre-review gates and pauses outside the process are excluded.

projection_assumptions: Same 41/114 routing mix and all 25 audited Sonnet process durations and costs. Scale the 111 covered classifier rounds to 800; the three missing rounds receive the estimated mean. Include packet preparation, retries, calls and general-reviewer fallback. Replay preparation uses the mean of four production panels; five untimed no-call preparations use the mean of 68 called attempts. Integration call costs use historical pinned Jev 1.13 usage; panel costs are recorded. Exclude shared gates, general-reviewer prompt preparation, final workflow bookkeeping, extra repairs, upkeep and human attention. Sample-based planning estimates, not measured monthly savings or confidence intervals.

extra_question_comparison.status: reused historical rounds; tuning; obligation bar .90, added question bar .85

scope: Jev decisions for integration-gate repairs and general re-reviews. The comparison includes reruns after finding an inactive classification path; original counts and rerun provenance are retained. First review, human approval, local integration gates and upstream CI integration remain required.
quality: Selected case investigations establish a repair-introduced duplicate-key defect and a separate reviewer-model-change case. They do not establish a population error rate.

preservation_illustration.evidence_kind: schematic policy examples, not measured repairs
preservation_illustration.preserves: Fix a code or test regression while preserving the intended behaviour and required assertions
preservation_illustration.weakens: Delete or weaken a test or required assertion, leaving intended behaviour unchecked
preservation_illustration.execution: Both schematic test runs report PASS; the reviewer judges whether the repair preserved the intended check

excluded_population.reason: Prior approval restored mechanically without a model review; excluded from the 114-round comparison and monthly projections.

agent_findings_before_human_involvement.boundary: Earlier of the first handoff to human approval or the first recorded human note not authored by the workflow. Findings must precede that boundary.
agent_findings_before_human_involvement.measure: Recorded agent review findings, not independently verified unique bugs or measured human attention.
agent_findings_before_human_involvement.cross_check: Independent SQL count against persisted structured findings equals the event-derived 26; px stats completed-mission cohort equals 39.

comparison.evidence: 37 local integration repair clears and four general re-review clears within the same 114 rounds. The general re-review classifier path was inactive because of a routing bug; its 42 affected rounds were rerun using the original evidence and fixed policy. Original live counts are retained separately.

panel_replay.rerun_reason: A routing bug left the existing general re-review classification path inactive for 42 rounds.
panel_replay.protocol: Bypass only the erroneous review-obligations dispatch. Reconstruct evidence available at each original attempt; retain the same packet builder, three frozen questions, thresholds and pinned model. Four recorded production panel packet hashes match exactly. No production votes or mission/statistics writes.

additional_panel_overhead.method: Measured replay-panel component of the 111 covered classifier rounds; three questions run in parallel. Include this component in the total sample mean; exclude calls from retired experimental paths.

general_rereview_example.change: One callback type annotation; runtime behaviour and assertions unchanged.
general_rereview_example.evidence: One of the four restored-panel clears, matching the recorded general approval at the same revision. Full provenance remains in panel_replay.

projection_period_assumption: Illustrative month of 800 re-reviews: four weeks at the earlier illustrative 200 per week, not an observed monthly rate or a calendar-month forecast.

review_requests_for_changes.unit: One repository/mission/round with a recorded decision; not missions, findings or model calls.
review_requests_for_changes.method: Round decisions take precedence. If absent, use the latest recorded non-human reviewer outcome event for that same round. Scope by decision time, repository parallix and pull-request change kind. Exclude classifier decisions and mechanical restorations from the general-reviewer baseline. Do not treat missing evidence as approval or infer outcomes from prose, commits or round count.

sample.restored_panel: The four rerun clears were general-approved at the same revisions, so do not alter the 18 returns.
sample.boundary: One confirmed missed repair defect; not an exhaustive count of misses. Selected suspect cases were investigated, not all clears uniformly adjudicated. A request for changes is a recorded reviewer judgment, not verified ground truth.

estimate.basis: Subtract the sample's known loss of 1/114 reviews from the historical general re-review return share. Hold case mix, review scope and repair attempts fixed; no workflow simulation. This is a sample-based extrapolation, not a validated population estimate or confidence interval. This uses at least one known miss from selected investigations, not an exhaustive miss count; further misses would lower the combined rate. The historical general-reviewer cohort and current mixed-route sample differ and are not matched.

review_requests_for_changes.start_rationale: First complete Europe/Stockholm day after the TASK-2347 through TASK-2369 statistics repairs. Later review-persistence fixes motivate using recorded outcome events when round decisions are absent.

classifier_overhead_estimate.method: Include all decision-relevant production attempts, retries and the 42 restored-panel replays. Recorded provider time counts parallel panels by elapsed time. Add recorded production packet preparation; impute untimed replay preparation from four production panels and five untimed no-call preparations from the 68 called attempts. Apply the resulting mean over 111 covered rounds to 800. General prompt preparation, shared gates and final workflow bookkeeping are excluded. Integration-call costs use historical pinned Jev 1.13 usage; production and replay panel costs are reported. Planning estimates, not confidence intervals or significance tests.

review_timing_audit.completion_boundary: Classifier: preparation start through enclosing workflow completion. General approval: reviewer process launch through enclosing workflow completion. General prompt preparation is outside that boundary. Different samples, not paired trials; missing completion records are not imputed into these observed means.
review_timing_audit.whole_round_boundary: The round clock opens before shared pre-review rebase/gates and can retain an old start across resumed work. It does not measure time removed by Jev.
review_timing_audit.longest_tool: Browser E2E command inside the reviewer invocation; retained in both means.
